scope: Frontend full-owned-source unit/component coverage with API substitutes. Backend unit/HTTP summary copied separately; combined database coverage is a separate artifact.
assessment: Coverage floors prevent regression; the repository does not yet have 100% coverage on every metric. This inventory discloses remaining paths, not an approved blanket exemption from the course rubric. All gaps are not claimed impossible to test.
location_note: Uncovered implicit else branches with empty locations use their enclosing branch location, marked parent_location_used. Locations come from V8/Istanbul source maps, not a claim every generated branch has independent business meaning.
unmeasured_boundaries: Live connected Supabase acceptance for this patch

instrumentation_notes.note: Negative count emitted by the instrumentation/report merge; included as uncovered consistently with the summary, not interpreted as actual negative executions.

release_qualifications.item: Keep connected safety/readiness/completion retests separate from API-substitute component/browser results. Local coverage cannot establish those outcomes.
Use browser and CI results from the final integrated commit. This inventory does not itself establish reviewed, merged or code-freeze readiness.

VenueBlocksPage 401/catalogue failure, signed-in account change in EventDraftEditPage, uncertain draft-submit failure, and EventRequestForm numeric/400/403 handling remain testable paths. No actual failure is asserted just because a path is unhit.
Root mounting, retained unused component/helper, defensive fallbacks and optional presentation explain remaining gaps. They remain in the denominator; most can be exercised with additional fixtures.
